purpose: Evidence-to-action guides for language learning decisions and reliable AI workflows.

pathways.title: Diagnose before you drill
pathways.description: Map the task, classify the error, and choose the next practice from evidence instead of repetition.
pathways.description_zh: 先定位任务和错误类型，再依据证据选择下一次练习，而不是机械重复。

pathways.title: Read from evidence
pathways.description: Use textual clues for vocabulary, implication, factual, inference, and main-purpose decisions.
pathways.description_zh: 用文本线索处理词义、隐含意义、事实、推断和主旨判断。

pathways.title: Listen for structure
pathways.title_zh: 听结构，而不是逐字翻译
pathways.description: Capture purpose, constraints, tone, and resolution without turning notes into a transcript.
pathways.description_zh: 抓住目的、限制、语气和解决方式，避免把笔记写成逐字稿。

pathways.title: Build an answer under constraints
pathways.title_zh: 在限制条件下组织答案
pathways.description: Plan, adapt, deliver, and revise speaking or writing responses with reusable structures.
pathways.description_zh: 用可复用结构完成口语或写作的规划、调整、表达和检查。

pathways.title: Allocate limited test time
pathways.description: Use checkpoints and recovery rules instead of rigid minute-by-minute schedules.
pathways.description_zh: 使用检查点和恢复规则，而不是僵硬的逐分钟计划。

pathways.title: Define the task and output
pathways.description: Turn an ambiguous request into clear instructions, context boundaries, examples, and a checkable output contract.
pathways.description_zh: 把模糊需求转成清晰指令、上下文边界、示例和可检查的输出契约。

pathways.title: Evaluate before you replace
pathways.description: Use fixed cases, explicit checks, failure logs, and version history to compare prompt changes.
pathways.description_zh: 用固定用例、明确检查、失败日志和版本记录比较提示词变化。

pathways.title: Verify before reuse
pathways.description: Separate evidence, model output, reviewer judgment, and unresolved uncertainty before information enters later work.
pathways.description_zh: 在信息进入后续工作前，区分证据、模型输出、审核判断和未解决的不确定性。

pathways.title: Control failure and rollback
pathways.title_zh: 控制失败并保留回退能力
pathways.description: Match review, refusal, rollout, and rollback controls to the cost of an AI-assisted error.
pathways.description_zh: 根据 AI 辅助错误的代价配置审核、拒绝、试点和回退控制。

toefl-listening-conversation-strategy.title: TOEFL Listening Conversations: Track Fact, Function, and Tone
toefl-listening-conversation-strategy.description: A three-layer note-taking method for separating explicit facts, speaker purpose, and pragmatic tone in TOEFL conversations.

toefl-listening-note-taking.title: TOEFL Listening Note-Taking: Build a Three-Column Structural Map
toefl-listening-note-taking.description: Capture main ideas, relationships, and evidence without attempting to transcribe an entire TOEFL lecture or conversation.

toefl-primary-reading-guide-2.title: TOEFL Primary Reading: Use a Three-Step Context Loop
toefl-primary-reading-guide-2.description: A child-friendly context routine for choosing a likely meaning, checking it against the sentence, and revising when evidence disagrees.

toefl-reading-fact-negative-fact.title: TOEFL Factual and Negative Factual Questions: Locate, Verify, Eliminate
toefl-reading-fact-negative-fact.description: Separate factual from negative-factual tasks, retrieve the controlling sentence, and eliminate choices with explicit evidence.

toefl-reading-inference-strategy-2.title: TOEFL Reading Inference Questions: Link Evidence Before You Deduce
toefl-reading-inference-strategy-2.description: A repeatable evidence-link-deduce method for making the smallest inference supported by a TOEFL passage.

toefl-reading-main-idea-purpose-2.title: TOEFL Main Idea and Purpose Questions: Use the H-F-E Framework
toefl-reading-main-idea-purpose-2.description: Use hierarchy, function, and evidence to distinguish a passage's central claim from examples and paragraph-level purposes.

toefl-reading-question-types-2.title: TOEFL Reading Question Types: Choose the Method Before the Answer
toefl-reading-question-types-2.description: Identify the question's evidence demand first, then apply the matching factual, vocabulary, inference, or purpose routine.

toefl-reading-time-management.title: TOEFL Reading Time Management: Use Checkpoints and Recovery Rules
toefl-reading-time-management.description: A flexible timing protocol that switches between careful reading and targeted retrieval while preserving time to recover.

toefl-speaking-independent-task.title: TOEFL Speaking Task 1: Build and Deliver a PREP-2 Response
toefl-speaking-independent-task.description: Choose a defensible position, prepare two reasons, and deliver a structured independent-speaking response under the time limit.

toefl-writing-academic-discussion.title: TOEFL Academic Discussion Writing: Contribute Instead of Repeating
toefl-writing-academic-discussion.description: A ten-minute protocol for choosing a stance, adding a distinct contribution, and connecting it to the ongoing discussion.

toefl-speaking-templates-2.title: TOEFL Speaking Templates: Scaffold, Adapt, and Avoid Memorized Answers
toefl-speaking-templates-2.description: Use adaptable speaking scaffolds while preserving task-specific reasoning, natural delivery, and evidence.
